title: Investment Policy Statement — operative copy
content:
Prepared for Karen Reed. Adopted and signed June 18, 2025, replacing the February 12 policy. Scope: retirement investment portfolio across the workplace plan, IRA and taxable brokerage.

Strategic weights and permissible bands: diversified equities 50% (45–55%); investment-grade fixed income 45% (40–50%); cash 5% (3–10%). No single issuer may exceed 5% except U.S. Treasury obligations. Review allocations quarterly and rebalance when a band is breached, taking taxes into account.

title: Employer Savings Plan 401(k) — Summary Plan Description
content:
Participant file: Jamie Krag | Employer Savings Plan | Account ending 0148. Governing summary effective January 1, 2025; document furnished by the plan administrator.

Section 7 — In-service withdrawals. An active employee who has reached age 59½ may request a distribution from vested elective deferrals. Before that age, those deferrals are generally unavailable except for an approved hardship under the plan. Vested rollover balances may be distributed while employed at any age. Submit requests to the plan administrator for review.

title: Individual Disability Income Policy — Future Purchase Option rider
content:
Example Willow Mutual | Policy DI-EX-804 | Insured: Aimee Smith-Krag. Endorsement effective February 1, 2025. This rider attaches to the individual disability policy, not the hospital's group plan.

On each policy anniversary through age 55, the insured may apply for up to $500 per month of added benefit within the remaining option pool of $2,000 per month. The insurer requires proof of eligible earnings and other coverage; no new medical evidence or exam is required. Submit the election within 60 days of the anniversary.
